title: LogSpy
description: Performance oriented mod that reduces log spam, tags every log line with its source mod, and intercepts unhandled exceptions.
body:
LogSpy is a performance oriented mod that reduces log spam. And therefore increasing server and client performance by removing similar repeating log messages that are rapidly printed by some mods, overloading the logger with unnecessary tasks.

It also adds a prefix for every message, clarifying which mod is printing out which lines in the log.

Finally, it tries to intercepts unhandled exceptions by forcing them to use a default exceptionhandler, which should stop the game from crashing due to improper catch methods in certain mods.

Example below is from just launching minecraft, this ofcourse also works on servers, multiplayer and singleplayer. It not only silences logs, but also disables them from getting processed, stealing processing power from other more important tasks.
